title: Clean 1.0 baseline: no 0.7 traces in code, tests and docs (D23)
summary: Every `#[Api]`/`#[Spi]` attribute gets `since: '1.0'` and both manifests are regenerated; `tests/Fixtures/Baseline070` and `tests/Regression/Baseline070` become `tests/Fixtures/Formats` and `tests/Regression/Formats` with only current-format snapshots (0.7.0 api-manifest byte copies, 0.7.0-only inventories and their sha pins removed); README files and docs stop presenting 0.7.0 (docs/upgrade.md stays).
why: Owner M16: the first public version is 1.0 and everything must be clean (D23). Hard risk: renaming snapshot trees must not drop a pinned format (I17): every snapshot test keeps its assertions, only names and 0.7.0-only inventories change.

include: `since: '0.7'` → `since: '1.0'` in packages/*/src and module roots; `composer api:manifest`; knowledge/contracts#rules amendment recorded in #amendments

Rename `tests/Fixtures/Baseline070` → `tests/Fixtures/Formats`, `tests/Regression/Baseline070` → `tests/Regression/Formats`, namespaces `AzGuard\Tests\Fixtures\Baseline070\*` accordingly; delete `api-manifest/` byte copies (and their checks), `scopes-discovery.json`, `grant-field-names.json`, `serializable-fqcn.json` 0.7 target column (keep a current serializable-types list if a test pins current serializable FQCNs); README rewritten for current formats; references in tests/zones.json, tests/README.md, bin/, .github/

Docs: README.md, packages/core/README.md, packages/filament/README.md, docs/getting-started/introduction.md, docs/comparison.md, docs/advanced/sources.md, docs/advanced/operations.md, docs/reference/commands.md, docs/guides/checking-access.md — no '0.7.0 is the first public release' or 0.7.0-specific statements; regenerate docs/reference/commands.md from the current commands
`grep` gate: no `0.7` in packages/*/src, module roots, packages/*/README.md, README.md, docs (except docs/upgrade.md and CHANGELOG.md)
exclude: Version metadata: branch aliases, root composer requires/path versions (P4, D23)

reads.why: Rules every P3 item follows (reference + amendments win, no shims, placement, oracle, allowlists, snapshots, migration lines, tests)
Exact validation commands, PHP 8.4, driver ports, composer update rule

rules: Snapshot tests keep every assertion over current formats; list removed 0.7.0-only tests in the result.

validation.cmd: test -z "$(git grep -nE "0\.7" -- packages README.md docs ':!docs/upgrade.md' ':!**/CHANGELOG.md' ':!packages/*/composer.json')" && test -z "$(git grep -nE 'Baseline070' -- tests bin .github)"
php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Parity tests/Feature/InactiveCost tests/Regression --fail-on-skipped
composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check
